description.html: The pirate ship is a decorative aquarium piece that adds an interesting visual accent and a functional hiding place for fish. The detailed ship with pirate motifs instantly draws attention and becomes the centerpiece of the aquarium. The hollow parts of the ship - the hull and deck - let fish swim through it and use it as a hiding place, which is especially useful for shyer species that need places to retreat. It is made from material that is safe for underwater use and does not affect water parameters. Ideal for kids' aquariums or for anyone who wants a themed aquarium with nautical motifs. Combine it with the ship wheel and anchor for a complete pirate look.
